from solution import check_equilateral
import inspect


def test_issue_example_6_8_12_false():
    """Paraphrases 'assert check_equilateral(6,8,12)==False'."""
    assert check_equilateral(6, 8, 12) == False  # 6==8==12? No (6!=8) -> False


def test_issue_equilateral_5_5_5_true():
    """Checks equilateral triangle returns True when x==y==z."""
    assert check_equilateral(5, 5, 5) == True  # 5==5==5? Yes -> True


def test_issue_equilateral_1_1_1_true():
    """Checks equilateral triangle with unit sides returns True."""
    assert check_equilateral(1, 1, 1) == True  # 1==1==1? Yes -> True


def test_issue_isosceles_first_two_equal_false():
    """Checks non-equilateral with only x==y returns False."""
    assert check_equilateral(5, 5, 7) == False  # 5==5!=7, not all equal -> False


def test_issue_isosceles_last_two_equal_false():
    """Checks non-equilateral with only y==z returns False."""
    assert check_equilateral(7, 5, 5) == False  # 7!=5, not all equal -> False


def test_issue_isosceles_outer_two_equal_false():
    """Checks non-equilateral with only x==z returns False."""
    assert check_equilateral(5, 7, 5) == False  # 5!=7, not all equal -> False


def test_issue_scalene_3_4_5_false():
    """Checks scalene triangle returns False when all sides differ."""
    assert check_equilateral(3, 4, 5) == False  # 3!=4!=5, not all equal -> False


def test_issue_float_equilateral_true():
    """Checks equilateral triangle with floats returns True."""
    assert check_equilateral(2.5, 2.5, 2.5) == True  # 2.5==2.5==2.5? Yes -> True


def test_issue_float_near_miss_false():
    """Checks nearly equilateral with value just above returns False."""
    assert check_equilateral(2.0, 2.0, 2.001) == False  # 2.0==2.0!=2.001 -> False


def test_contract_result_is_bool_when_false():
    """Quotes 'assert check_equilateral(6,8,12)==False' implying bool result."""
    result = check_equilateral(6, 8, 12)  # 6!=8 so result is False
    assert isinstance(result, bool) == True  # type(result)==bool? Yes -> True


def test_contract_result_is_bool_when_true():
    """Paraphrases equilateral-or-not check implying bool result for True."""
    result = check_equilateral(4, 4, 4)  # 4==4==4? Yes so result is True
    assert isinstance(result, bool) == True  # type(result)==bool? Yes -> True


def test_contract_takes_three_parameters():
    """Paraphrases public interface 'def check_equilateral(x, y, z)'."""
    assert len(inspect.signature(check_equilateral).parameters) == 3  # x+y+z = 1+1+1 = 3
